title: Permanent Residents - Monthly IRCC Updates: Canada - Admissions of Permanent Residents by Province/Territory and Census Metropolitan Area of Intended Destination
referencePeriod: January 2015 to August 2026 (monthly); annual totals 2015-2025; year-to-date 2026-01 to 2026-08
licence: Open Government Licence - Canada
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Source: IRCC, Permanent Residents - Monthly IRCC Updates.
transformations: Read the XLSX (not the CSV, which IRCC labels 'rounded - not for calculations'); took each row's calendar-year Total column (annual totals) and the 2026 year-to-date total (January-August).

IRCC rounds every value to the nearest 5 and shows 0-5 as '--' (kept as null + suppressed flag); all values carry the 'rounded' flag. Calendar-year totals are published values and may not equal the sum of monthly cells.

Rows are 'CMA' per IRCC, which includes some census agglomerations (Charlottetown, Brandon, Whitehorse, Yellowknife are present). Ottawa - Gatineau is published as Ontario part and Quebec part and used as such.
Change = (latest-year / previous-year - 1) x 100 on rounded values; per-1,000 = admissions / StatCan July 1 population x 1000.
notes: Admissions are by intended destination at landing, not current residence.
Dataset metadata last modified 2026-10-20; file last-modified header Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:31:40 GMT.
Iqaluit: IRCC publishes Nunavut only as 'Other - Nunavut', so no Iqaluit value is available.

title: Population estimates, July 1, by census metropolitan area and census agglomeration, 2021 boundaries
licence: Statistics Canada Open Licence
attribution: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 17-10-0148-01. Reproduced and distributed on an 'as is' basis with the permission of Statistics Canada.
transformations: Kept Gender='Total - gender' and Age group='All ages'; matched each place by DGUID suffix to its CMA/CA code (Ottawa and Gatineau by their Ontario/Quebec part).
Used as the denominator for admissions per 1,000 (same calendar year, July 1 estimate).
notes: Population estimates on 2021 boundaries; may be revised.

title: Immigrant taxfilers by economic outcomes and tax year, Canada, provinces and census metropolitan areas, 2023 constant dollars
licence: Statistics Canada Open Licence
attribution: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 43-10-0030-01. Reproduced and distributed on an 'as is' basis with the permission of Statistics Canada.
transformations: Streamed the ~16 GB full-table CSV and kept Sex='Total, sex', Pre-admission experience='Total', Knowledge of official languages='Total' and Statistics in {Total number of residents, Median employment income, Median wages salaries and commissions} for Canada, provinces and our CMAs (data/raw/statcan_tables/43100030/filtered_northward.csv).
Years since admission = tax year (REF_DATE) minus admission year; the admission-year-equals-tax-year cell is not published.

imm_median_wages_5y = Median wages, salaries and commissions, admission year 2018, tax year 2023, category total; Charlottetown and Brandon use the provincial value (flagged provincial_value); territories have no data.
Values rounded by StatCan (flag rounded); '..' -> null + not_available.
notes: Population: immigrant taxfilers aged 15 and older residing in Canada (IMDB: IRCC landing records linked to tax files). Income in 2023 constant dollars; values zero and one excluded from medians. Geography = postal code on the tax return (may differ from province of taxation).
Admission year = year of first landing/PR status, which may differ from arrival year.

title: Mobility of immigrant taxfilers by census metropolitan areas and tax year
licence: Statistics Canada Open Licence
attribution: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 43-10-0022-01. Reproduced and distributed on an 'as is' basis with the permission of Statistics Canada.
transformations: Streamed the ~20 GB full-table CSV from the zip (not extracted) and kept Age group='Total, age group', Pre-admission experience='Total', Knowledge of official languages='Total' for Canada, provinces and our CMAs (data/raw/statcan_tables/43100022/filtered_northward.csv).

Used Statistics='Retention rate' (percent) for admission year 2018 in tax year 2023 (5 years after admission), category total; province values flagged provincial_value on place observations; CMA values as imm_retention_cma_5y.
Series: retention by years since admission for the 2015 cohort (tax years 2016-2023).
notes: 'Retention rate represents the percentage of immigrant taxfilers continuing their residence in the geographical area (province or CMA) of intended destination ... This does not take into account immigrants migrating in from another destination.' (table note 11). Retention = stayed / (stayed + out migration).
Table covers Canada, provinces and CMAs; no territories or census agglomerations.
